value.question: orient-floor-authors-and-provenance-is-measured is PROVED, sealed, and its build was never charted. Does it owe its chain retroactively, or does it stand?
value.reading_it_owes: The chain is what authorizes a build, and an unauthorized build in proven-space is exactly Law 8's hollow. Cost of this reading, stated plainly so it is not chosen by accident: the only way to pay it is to author orient/survey/decompose KNOWING the answers, which produces a chain that is true about content and fiction about sequence — and once that is done for one voyage it is available to every future one as 'chart it afterwards'. That is the gate learning to accept its own bypass.
value.reading_it_stands: The gate did not ask, so nothing was smuggled past a question that was put. The build is real, its proofs are real, its watch is armed and its validation is sealed; what is missing is the preamble's LEARNING (the trees got no deposit), not the build's correctness. Cost of this reading: a voyage that skipped the preamble is indistinguishable at rest from one that ran it, forever.
value.what_CC_did_with_the_sibling_while_this_: Nothing that presumes either answer. `constrain-floor-authors-and-provenance-is-measured` is in the identical position (code committed at fe71a6d, 16 proof teeth, validation sealed, WATCHME probe armed, ticket at TICKETME, no chain, no component history at all) and CC did NOT take route B to move it, and did NOT author it a retroactive chart. It stays where it is with the finding recorded on it.
value.why_it_is_yours_and_not_CC's: Both answers are defensible and they build different things. CC will not pick by which one costs less work — that is the disposition the 2026-08-14 rule forbids wearing a design argument's clothes.
